def PEMS.Theorem_1_1.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {𝕜 : Type u_1} →

    {X : Type u_2} →

fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] {X} {Y} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] μ ν T =>
  PEMS.StrictlyLocalizable μ →
    PEMS.StrictlyLocalizable ν →
      ∃ W,
        ThesisCommon.IsWeaklyCompactOperator W ∧
          ThesisCommon.weakEssentialNorm T = ‖T - W‖ ∧ ‖T - W‖ = PEMS.localizedWeakNoncompactness T

fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] K L [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K] [T2Space K] [TopologicalSpace L] [CompactSpace L]
    [T2Space L] T =>
